page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is a general-purpose, high-frequency instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The underlying processor is an Intel Xeon 8269CY. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage volumes for operating systems and data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating reliable data transfer rates for distributed environments.

This hardware profile is optimized for workloads requiring high single-core performance and predictable compute resources. The dedicated core allocation and 3.1 GHz clock speed make it suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, application servers, and database hosting where hyperthreading overhead must be avoided.
